combinations.subjects: Business Studies, Accountancy, Basic Mathematics, Statistics
Business Studies, Accountancy, Basic Mathematics, Economics

process: Obtain application form from the college or admissions office after SSLC result declaration.
Submit completed application with 4 passport-size photographs and an attested copy of 10th marksheet.
Admissions are conducted on a first-come, first-served basis based on the merit list.
required_documents: SSLC / 10th standard original marks card + photocopies
Provisional Eligibility Certificate (issued by Department of Pre-University Education for non-Karnataka / international candidates)
Income Certificate (if annual family income is below ₹44,500)

examination_rules.i_puc: Promotional exam conducted at the district level. Candidate must score at least 30% marks in each subject and 35% overall aggregate to get promoted to II PUC.
examination_rules.ii_puc: Final state-level examination conducted by the Karnataka Department of Pre-University Education.
